tokenless_endpoint.question: should the tokenless /mcp/<server> self-provision an anonymous tenant per session instead of 401ing

premise_correction.evidence: measured live 2026-09-10: options[0].how and the connect field both name https://mcp.zovo.one/mcp/connect; the funnel agent has since also put it first in the message field

tokenless_endpoint.session_id_evidence: sessionIdGenerator: undefined in remote/src/index.ts; SDK webStandardStreamableHttp.js:726 'session management is disabled'; live initialize returns 200 with no mcp-session-id header

breaks.why: state lives at ${tenant}:${server} in KV with a 30-day TTL; a session-scoped tenant is not resumable, so a ledger written today is unreachable tomorrow with no error
TOKEN_MINTS_PER_IP=10/hour/IP is bypassed; every prober that POSTs tools/call creates a tok: record and a tenant document with a 30-day TTL, swept only after 35 idle days
a hosted purchase is bound as bind:<anonToken>; a tenant that dies with the session cannot be bound to, so a user who pays is on the free tier and has lost their data on the next connection

tokenless_endpoint.undermines_licence_model_note: checked in code: decideBinding and rateLimit key off auth.tenant regardless of provenance and the free tier is already keyless; the objection is durability, not generosity

recommended_alternative.what: on a tokenless tools/call ONLY, mint under the existing per-IP ceiling and return ready_to_use { token, url, how } inside the same 401
recommended_alternative.why: an offer, not a grant: still 401, nothing served, same token GET /mcp/token gives anyone; keeps the token visible, savable, portable and bindable at checkout
recommended_alternative.blocked_by: the funnel agent rewrote unauthorizedBody() and its call site during this task; remote/test/unauthorized-body.test.mjs pins the exact signature unauthorizedBody(product: string) and the call-site string, so adding a parameter breaks that suite
recommended_alternative.size: ~15 lines: optional offer param spliced into the body, mint guarded by !hasCredential && rpc.method === 'tools/call'

further_notes: the 401 body is not a JSON-RPC envelope, so a conforming client parsing it as JSON-RPC finds nothing; making it one conflicts with the existing top-level error string

www-authenticate: Bearer is already sent and is the hook the MCP authorization spec uses to start OAuth automatically - the only mechanism that truly solves one-URL-many-users for a registry; needs an authorization server, a human step
